reviewed_semantics: Metadata uses the existing full batch interpolate traversal separately for position and jump-aware velocity; it does not reselect scalar stencils.

Typed tangent v2 serializes exact/ordinary/anchored-twofold mode, actual local anchor, indices and hexadecimal high/low terms. Grid sample stencils are identities; extra drag samples reuse captured metadata.
Anchored coefficients are combined exactly as 1 minus the sum of nonanchor weights at the anchor. No weight normalization or coefficient cutoff is introduced.

The bounded diagnostic lift coalesces dyadic rows exactly then records every nonzero binary64 rounding error; overflow and nonzero underflow fail. This is not a claim of identical finite-precision execution.

The overlay is an explicitly pinned isolated post-install step. Ordinary repository installers and public defaults remain unchanged. The complete surrounding source/runtime dependencies must still be pinned by native build controls.
required_actual_gates: Compile and execute native batch interpolation and serializer fixtures with the pinned native compiler; verify serializer-to-decoder roundtrip.
Demonstrate positive flight extra-time support, actual batch Time/searchStart selection, distinct position/velocity pulse support, sameTimes identity and shifted computational cuts.
Verify native/lifted tangent equivalence within unchanged tolerances, including anchored nonnormalized high/low weights, and unchanged GNSS query/variation/covariance equivalence.
Run distinct exact long-arc failures and full fixed-target closures, then the complete unchanged correctness and shifted-cut suite before preparation.
